name: h3_resume_after_v2
purpose: Track A: resume the registered H3 runner (4 evaluations + analysis; both arms are trained by then) after the v2 campaign, post-v2, the causal caches and X1; the pause flag is kept (renamed), not deleted

jobs.name: consume_pause_flag
cmd: import pathlib,time; d=pathlib.Path('experiments/anti_uav/runs/_h3_optimisation'); f=d/'PAUSE_AFTER_ARM'; f.exists() and f.rename(d/('PAUSE_AFTER_ARM.consumed_'+time.strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S'))); print('pause flag consumed' if not f.exists() else 'flag still present')
